name: codebase-kb-engine
description: Generate a verifiable knowledge base for any repository, read-only: five human-readable docs (architecture, workflows, business rules, system context) plus a machine-readable ckb.json conforming to the open CKB v0.1 spec, with path:line provenance and confidence on every claim. Works on a local path or a repo URL (ephemeral, push-disabled clone). A fail-closed, session-scoped gate keeps the analysed repo untouched.
